statements.proposition: In template_to_pic, when base_url is not provided the navigation URL defaults to file://{template_path}, as before.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Literal branch (a pages dict lacking base_url) does use file://{template_path}. But the default call (pages=None) fills pages with base_url=file://{getcwd()} first, so base_url is then 'provided' and goto now uses file://cwd instead of the old file://{template_path}. The common default case therefore does not default to file://{template_path}; judged FALSE for the default case, so the 'maintains backward compatibility' part fails.
